title: Real-time macro data layer (US, euro area, Italy): code, catalogue and validation
description: Validated, reproducible data layer for forecasting interest rates, inflation and unemployment in the US, the euro area and Italy, with real-time vintages. 27 datasets, 1,060 series, 7.2 M observations from FRED, ECB, Eurostat, Philadelphia Fed (RTDSM, SPF), Federal Reserve Board and the Kenneth French Data Library; 133/133 automated validation checks pass. The deposit contains the collection and validation code, the data catalogue, the validation report and the sha256 manifest of the raw files; the data themselves are downloaded from the providers under their own terms. Part of IRP 15, Deep Generation of Financial Time Series, MSCA Doctoral Network Digital Finance.
